findings.claim: 報導指出市場擔憂 CPO 隨埠速推向 1.6T 可能取代 Credo 的 AEC 本業；Credo 已於 5/28 完成收購 DustPhotonics 以補光學能力
findings.source: Crypto Briefing: Credo Technology slides as Wall Street weighs whether optical tech could replace its copper cash cow
findings.excerpt: the concern centers on Co-Packaged Optics, or CPO, which could eventually replace Credo's bread-and-butter Active Electrical Cables as data center port speeds push toward 1.6 terabits per second

findings.claim: SemiVision 分析認為 AEC 是機櫃內短距互連的最佳解，大規模 CPO 部署預期在 2027–2029 之後
findings.source: SemiVision: The AI Interconnect War – Copper Fights
findings.excerpt: Active Electrical Cable (AEC) has emerged as the optimal solution for short-reach in-rack interconnects in AI data centers.

findings.claim: TrendForce：microLED CPO 功耗可降至銅纜方案約 5%；Credo 以 Hyperlume 基礎的 Active Light Cable 預計 FY2027 送樣、FY2028 量產（廠商/分析師預估，非實測部署）
findings.source: TrendForce News: micro LED optical interconnect ecosystem
findings.excerpt: sample shipments expected in fiscal 2027, followed by volume production ramp-up in fiscal 2028

findings.claim: Semtech OFC 2026：銅纜仍是目前叢集規模最務實的 scale-up 互連，光學是並行進入而非取代；並展示 3.2T ACC（448G/lane）
findings.source: Semtech blog: OFC 2026 Semtech advances the future of AI data center optical and active copper interconnects
findings.excerpt: Copper remains the most practical scale-up interconnect for today's cluster sizes, but as AI clusters expand, optics is entering scale-up alongside copper, not replacing it.

note: LPO 對 AEC 的 2026 份額預測未找到；來源多為廠商/分析師觀點。
